risk_note: RV2 (db). Migration 0037 creates the ledger core tables (BR-FUND-13/15/16): ledger_accounts (one balance account per user, unique (app_id, owner_type, owner_id, subject)), ledger_vouchers (unique (app_id, uniq_key), nullable structured columns per ledger-plan D3), ledger_entries (monthly partitions plus DEFAULT, added to the ensure_month_partition allow-list and packages/db partitions.ts), account_balances (frozen_fen >= 0, version). Vouchers and entries are insert-only: UPDATE / DELETE rejected by triggers and not granted. couli_app SELECT / INSERT on vouchers and entries, SELECT / INSERT / UPDATE on balances; couli_readonly SELECT only (D8). Named constraints and indexes; bigint *_fen. lint-migrations funds-table list gains the five table names. booked_at has no clock default (D2, application Clock). Generated schema.sql / db.gen.ts produced on the test machine after rebasing onto main with 0036. A frozen rule-test file was reformatted with prettier by the orchestrator (content unchanged). No application code; posting is B2-02f.
